verdict.rationale: Letta publishes a pricing page that documents a free starting path (BYOK models), a tier capped at up to 20 stateful agents, and a developer plan with usage-based pricing for unlimited agents. The evidence quotes no actual per-unit rates and nothing on memory or storage costs, so a buyer cannot project memory spend from it. Missing for 10: published per-unit rates, memory/storage-specific pricing, explicit free-tier limits, independent corroboration of pricing.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published pricing with a free tier and per-unit rates so I can project memory costs before committing

citations.quote: You can get started with Letta for free by using models with BYOK, including coding plans from ChatGPT/Codex, Kimi, and Z.AI.
With a developer plan, you can create an unlimited number of agents but pay usage-based pricing.
